title: 第二十八章 机遇第二十七章 幽光
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
那青鸾日后成长起来，神通广大，清鸣可破邪祟，展翅能御风雷，曾多次于生死之际相助千沐妍与司楚白。
难道眼前这颗幽光莹莹，隐现玄妙纹路的蛋，便是原著中对女主至关重要的青鸾蛋？
见千沐妍面容惨白地紧跟在司楚白身后，并无半点心神关注此处，时机稍纵即逝，谢清猗眸光一凝，趁着众人皆忙于应对崩塌，根本顾不上这边之时。
她广袖轻拂，袖中的纤指一旋，一道冰蓝的灵力在她指尖流转而出，她身形一动，避入一侧岩石之后。
抬眸看向远处，见无人看她，灵光才悄然探出，下一息，便涌入石缝中，那枚散发青蓝幽光的蛋包裹住，湛蓝灵光彻底遮掩了它的气息，她指尖轻点，那枚蛋便悄无声息地纳入指间的紫翡储物戒中。
在蛋入戒的一刹那，蛋壳表面若隐若现的浮现出金色翎羽状光纹，微微一闪随即暗去，她眸光微闪，看来她应是猜对了。
突然，一块巨大落石，从天而降，轰然砸落在她与司楚白等人之间，她身形一闪，连忙避开，就见她们原先所站之处，碎石迸射，烟尘弥漫，彻底隔绝了大家视线，她抬手间形成一道淡蓝的防御结界，将自己包裹于内。
秘境并未消停，接二连三的巨石砸落，大家纷纷避闪着，谢清猗见大家自顾不暇，更是无人关注她。
便趁机借那些坠石，激起的混乱气流与反冲之力，脚尖轻点，裙裾翻飞，在尘土中划过一抹银白，身形犹如灵蛇，灵敏地在纷落地碎石上轻盈一点。
几个起落，便已悄然离开那片混乱，最后前往在无人的暗处，在一块还算完整的青石平地上翩然落下。
她望着远处依旧尘烟弥漫，轻拍胸口，嘟了嘟唇，这破地方，实在是太危险了！吓死她了，刚才应该没穿帮吧。
又回忆一番，心底嘀咕着，管他的呢，他们都差点噶了，谁还去注意她啊～安抚了自己几句，把自己说服一般，才服下一枚补灵丹，盘腿略作调息。
待丹田内灵力恢复了些后，才起身继续向洞穴深处行去。
走了没多久，见眼前甬道曲折，她迷路了……见也没有其他路可走，只能硬着头皮进入了。
她沿途留意，只是让她没想到的是，一句很是安静，她顺手也采掘了些许嵌在石中的铜金玉矿，又在潮湿像长着苔藓的岩缝间，摘了几株泛着幽光的罕见灵草。
想到这如同她玩网游时也是这般喜欢‘捡垃圾’，这股莫名的快乐，让她暂时将先前的恐惧淡化一些，此时只有填满包裹的爽感，这下发财了！毕竟这些皆是外界难寻之物。
就在她专注于眼前的‘采集’大业时，身后忽然传来一声带着惊喜的清朗男声：“谢师妹！”
她闻声回头，见顾怀瑾与沈江寒二人正快步从另一条岔道走来，身后还跟着十几名同门弟子。他们模样颇为狼狈，不少人衣袍破碎，虽然伤口亦然治愈，但法袍上，沾染着暗红血迹，尤其众人脸上，带着激战后的疲色与惊悸，显然先前经历了一场恶战。
谢清猗见同门身上带伤，连忙迎上两步，看向为首的两人，见他们法袍有些凌乱，但未见伤口，还是关心道：“顾师兄，沈师兄，你们没事吧？”心中轻哼，有人来她山头抢宝贝了！
“唉，别提了。”顾怀瑾摇了摇头，面带余悸地叹了口气，眸光沉了些，与身旁的沈江寒交换了一个眼神。

他嗓音有些干哑：“我们遭遇了一头极其凶悍的怪物。刚布下法阵准备应对，前方的秘境，不知为何，会毫无征兆地坍塌，而那孽畜趁乱袭击，伤了不少同门……”
他转身看向一脸颓败的弟子们，脸上浮现悲戚之色：“百里师弟他们，也与我们走散了。万幸的是，巨石落下，正好阻隔了那怪物的追击，我们才得以脱身。”他说完，看向谢清猗，“谢师妹，你这一路可还顺利？”
谢清猗将自己之前的经历简要说了一遍，自然略去了那枚蛋的事。“我们也是险象环生，先前……”
听罢，众人面色更是不好，气氛更加低沉。
“小猗儿，你人没事就好！可把师兄担心坏了。”沈江寒闻言，向前一步，抬手夸张地拍了拍自己胸口，又在她肩上拍了两下，清朗的嗓音力带着戏谑。
她抬眸见对方眼神认真，没好气地瞥了对方一眼，懒得理会这活宝。
目光扫过眼前仅存的十几人，除了顾怀瑾和沈江寒，其余弟子多是带伤挂彩，也不知那些失散乃至可能已罹难的同门，心头不免沉重，说不清是原身的记忆作祟，还是自己本就心肠软。
也不再纠结这些，大家毕竟同出一门，此番秘境之行更是生死与共，说不担忧是假的，当然，原书中的那对男女主角除外，他们的安危自有天命庇护。
“此地不宜久留，我们继续前进吧。”顾怀瑾沉稳的声音打破了略显沉闷的气氛，他率先迈步，领着这支伤痕累累，却意志更为坚定的众人，再次向秘境深处探寻而去。
天光昏暗，句余山死寂的外围，三道身影无声降临，慕宸立于前方，一袭玄色长袍刺着繁复符箓，其上金色暗纹缓缓流淌，隐有光华波动，气息深不可测，他深邃的眸光滑过一抹亮光，定定望向远处的诡谲之地。
身后的灼傲与泽渊，身着同色劲装，衣袍利落，紧贴悍利身形，周身那股久经杀伐的凛冽气魄，已远超寻常修士所能企及的境界。
二人见为首之人还未发话，只能微微垂眸，静立无言，泽渊悄悄侧头朝灼傲眨了眨眼，灼傲眉心收拢，薄唇紧抿，摇了摇头，又目不斜视，紧紧锁定前方那身形挺拔的身影，
“等下分头行事。”
慕宸清冽的嗓音传来，话音一落，身形骤然消失在他们眼前。
两人也未作停留，目光投向那片枯黑昏暗的山林深处，身形一晃，莫入幽暗。
下一瞬，他们的气息与身影已彻底与这片死寂的黑暗融为一体，再寻不到半分踪迹。
谢清猗与顾怀瑾，沈江寒领着余下的弟子，他们正于错综复杂的甬道中小心前行，同时沿途采集，此处灵气虽紊乱，却孕育出不少天材地宝，一路行来，众人收获颇丰，冲淡了先前的阴霾。
而此时，谢清猗她悄悄瞥了眼身边挖宝贝的同门，见大家这精神状态，哪里像刚刚死里逃生的样子，撇撇嘴，果然大家都是财迷……
灵植散发出幽幽微光，此处天材地宝确实丰富，引得众人收获颇丰。
“这里有龙骨草！”

身侧一名年轻弟子忽然惊喜叫道，指向一旁岩缝，那里正有一株泛着幽光的灵植，淡银的灵光在它细长的枝叶上流转着。叶子上覆盖着霜白光泽，经脉暗涌着深红，如同血液，他眸光晶亮，抬手便要去采。
“慢着！”

content_en:
Qingluan grew up in the future and had great supernatural powers. His clear voice could destroy evil spirits, and he could control wind and thunder with his wings. He helped Qian Muyan and Si Chubai many times in life and death.
Could it be that the shimmering egg in front of me with mysterious lines is the Qingluan egg that is crucial to the heroine in the original work?
Seeing Qian Muyan following Si Chubai with a pale face, not paying any attention to this place, the opportunity was fleeting, Xie Qingyi's eyes narrowed, while everyone was busy dealing with the collapse and couldn't care about this.
She flicked her wide sleeves and twirled her slender fingers. A stream of icy blue spiritual power flowed out from her fingertips. She moved and hid behind a rock.
She raised her eyes and looked into the distance. Seeing that no one was looking at her, the aura quietly poked out. The next breath, it poured into the crevices of the stone. The egg emitting a blue light was wrapped around it. The azure aura completely covered its aura. With a tap of her fingertips, the egg was quietly included in the purple jade storage ring between her fingers.
The moment the egg entered the ring, golden feather-like light patterns appeared faintly on the surface of the egg shell. It flashed slightly and then dimmed. Her eyes flashed slightly, and it seemed that she had guessed it right.
Suddenly, a huge falling rock fell from the sky, crashing down between her, Si Chubai and the others. She dodged and hurriedly avoided it. She saw where they were standing, rubble shooting out and smoke filling the air, completely cutting off everyone's sight. She raised her hand to form a light blue defensive barrier, wrapping herself in it.
The secret realm did not stop, and huge rocks fell one after another, and everyone dodged. Xie Qingyi saw that everyone was too busy taking care of themselves, and no one paid attention to her.
He took the opportunity to take advantage of the chaotic airflow and recoil force caused by the falling stones. He tapped his toes, and his skirt flew up, leaving a trace of silver in the dust. His body was like a snake, nimbly moving a little lighter on the falling gravel.
After a few ups and downs, he quietly left the chaos, and finally went to a dark place where there was no one, and landed gracefully on a relatively complete bluestone flat.
She looked at the distance still filled with dust and smoke. She patted her chest and pouted her lips. This poor place was really too dangerous! She was scared to death. She must have been naked just now.
After reminiscing again, I muttered in my heart, who cares, they were almost dead, who would pay attention to her~ After comforting myself with a few words and convincing myself, I took a spirit-boosting pill and crossed my legs for a while to adjust my breath.
After the spiritual power in the Dantian recovered, he stood up and continued walking deeper into the cave.
Not long after walking, she saw the twists and turns of the corridor in front of her, and she got lost... Seeing that there was no other way to go, she had no choice but to enter.
She paid attention along the way, but what she didn't expect was a very quiet word. She also excavated some copper, gold and jade ores embedded in the rocks, and picked a few rare spiritual herbs with a faint light in the moist crevices of the rocks that looked like moss.
Thinking that this was just like how she liked to 'pick up garbage' when playing online games, this inexplicable joy made her temporarily downplay her previous fear. At this time, she only had the refreshing feeling of filling the package, and now she was rich! After all, these are things that are hard to find in the outside world.
Just when she was focusing on the great task of 'collecting' in front of her, a clear male voice with surprise suddenly came from behind her: "Thank you, junior sister!"
When she heard the sound, she turned around and saw Gu Huaijin and Shen Jianghan walking quickly from another branch, followed by more than a dozen fellow disciples. They looked quite embarrassed, and many of them had broken robes. Although their wounds were healed, their robes were stained with dark red blood. Especially on their faces, they looked tired and frightened after a fierce battle. It was obvious that they had experienced a fierce battle before.
When Xie Qingyi saw that his fellow disciples were injured, he quickly took two steps forward and looked at the two leaders. He saw that their robes were a little messy, but there were no wounds. He still asked with concern: "Brother Gu, Senior Brother Shen, are you okay?" He hummed in his heart, someone came to her mountain to snatch the treasure!
"Oh, don't mention it." Gu Huaijin shook his head, sighed with lingering fear, his eyes became darker, and he met Shen Jianghan beside him.A look was exchanged.
His voice was a little hoarse: "We encountered an extremely ferocious monster. We had just set up the magic circle to prepare for it, but for some reason, the secret realm in front of us collapsed without warning, and the evil beast took advantage of the chaos to attack, injuring many of our fellow disciples..."
He turned to look at the defeated disciples, with a sad look on his face: "Junior Brother Baili and the others were also separated from us. Fortunately, the boulder fell, blocking the monster's pursuit, and we were able to escape." After he finished speaking, he looked at Xie Qingyi, "Junior Sister Xie, has your journey been smooth?"
Xie Qingyi briefly talked about his previous experience, naturally omitting the egg. "We are also in danger. Previously..."
After hearing this, everyone looked even worse and the atmosphere became even more gloomy.
"Xiao Yi'er, it's good that you're fine! But you're worrying me so much, Senior Brother." Upon hearing this, Shen Jianghan took a step forward, raised his hand and patted his chest exaggeratedly, and then patted her shoulder twice, his clear voice full of joking.
She raised her eyes and saw the other person's eyes were serious. She glanced at him angrily and was too lazy to pay attention to this living treasure.
His eyes swept over the dozen or so people left in front of him. Except for Gu Huaijin and Shen Jianghan, most of the other disciples were injured. He didn't know those fellow disciples who were separated or even died. He couldn't help but feel heavy in his heart. He couldn't tell whether it was the memory of the original disciples or his own soft-heartedness.
I no longer worry about these things. After all, we all come from the same sect, and this trip to the secret realm is about life and death. It would be false to say that we are not worried, except of course for the male and female protagonists in the original book. Their safety is protected by destiny.
"It's not advisable to stay here for a long time. Let's move on." Gu Huaijin's steady voice broke the slightly dull atmosphere. He took the lead and led this group of people who were scarred but more determined to explore the depths of the secret realm again.
The sky was dim, and three figures arrived silently at the silent periphery of Juyu Mountain. Mu Chen stood in front, wearing a black robe embroidered with complicated talismans. Golden dark lines flowed slowly on it, with faint fluctuations of light and unfathomable aura. A flash of light passed through his deep eyes, and he stared fixedly at the strange place in the distance.
Behind them, Zhuo Ao and Ze Yuan were dressed in the same colored attire. Their robes were neat and fit tightly against their powerful figures. The fierce aura around them that had been killed for a long time was far beyond the reach of ordinary monks.
Seeing that the leader had not yet spoken, the two of them could only lower their eyes slightly and stood silently. Zeyuan quietly turned his head and blinked at Zhuo Ao. Zhuo Ao narrowed his eyebrows, pursed his thin lips tightly, shook his head, and looked straight at the tall figure in front of him.
"We will split up later."
Mu Chen's clear voice came, and as soon as he finished speaking, his figure suddenly disappeared in front of them.
The two of them did not stop, and cast their gaze into the depths of the dark and dark mountain forest. Their bodies swayed, and they could not enter the darkness.
The next moment, their breath and figures were completely integrated into this dead darkness, and no trace of them could be found.
Xie Qingyi, Gu Huaijin, and Shen Jianghan led the remaining disciples. They were carefully moving forward in the intricate corridors, and at the same time collecting along the way. Although the spiritual energy here was chaotic, it gave birth to many treasures of heaven and earth. Along the way, everyone gained a lot, which diluted the previous gloom.
At this time, Xie Qingyi quietly glanced at her classmates who were digging for treasures. Seeing that everyone's mental state did not look like they had just escaped from death, she curled her lips. Sure enough, everyone was a money fan...
The spiritual plants emitted a faint light, and the treasures of heaven and earth were indeed abundant here, attracting everyone to gain a lot.
"There is dragon bone grass here!"
A young disciple beside him suddenly shouted in surprise and pointed to the crevice in the rock. There was a spiritual plant glowing with light, and the light silver spiritual light was flowing on its slender branches and leaves. The leaves were covered with frost-white luster, and the meridians were dark red, like blood. His eyes were bright and he raised his hand to pick them.
"Wait!"
